opennyai_summary.21_March_2023__decision:
After considering all the facts and circumstances of the case, nature and gravity of offence, and also taking note of the fact that prosecutrix is a 24 years old major and married lady, FIR is 3-4 months belated, MLC report has not supported the case of prosecution, investigation is over and charge sheet has been filed, but final conclusion of the trial will take sufficient long time, I deem it proper to release the appellant on bail.
Accordingly, the appeal is allowed.
It is directed that appellant be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.75,000/- (Rupees Seventy Five Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for his appearance before the trial Court, as and when required.
He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
